sites.name: Hole In The Ground Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $12 per night
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from a hand pump
sites.about: True to its name, Hole-in-the-Ground is tucked away in a steep, tree-covered draw alongside Mill Creek. A developed campground with 13 designated sites, you can really escape it all at HITG! Campfire rings and tables are provided. Only shorter travel trailers recommended, as the road in is very…
sites.directions: From Highway 172, take Forest Road 28N06 to access the campground.
sites.restrictions: campfires in fire rings only, all animals must be on a managed six (6) foot leash, quiet hours from 10pm to 6 am, no fireworks, must occupy site first night, and every night thereafter. Stay limit 14 days.

sites.name: Gurnsey Creek Group Camp
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Group (nonelectric) Site: $56 per night (Sites 31-37) Group Standard nonelectric: $112 per night (Sites 38-51)
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Gurnsey Group is located within Gurnsey Creek Campground. This unique site offers 2 reservable "loops". sites.directions: Gurnsey Creek Group Campground is located 14 miles west of Chester on Highway 36.
sites.restrictions: Fee must be paid upon arrival and prior to each night of camping, Fee regulations are strictly enforced. Quiet hours are 10pm to 6am. Campfires allowed only in provided fire rings. 2 vehicles (including RVs/Boats/Etc.) and 8 persons allowed in each campsite. Pets must remain on a leash or confined…
sites.reservations: Reservations for the group sites can be made at by visiting Recreation.gov. Reservations must be made 4 days ahead of arrival and can be made up to 12 months in advance. Individual campsites are first-come/first-served.

sites.name: Southwest Campground
sites.operator: National Park Service · Lassen Volcanic National Park
sites.about: The Southwest Campground (elevation 6700FT.) is a first come first serve campground. It has 20 walk-in tent sites and 5 RV sites located in the parking lot adjacent to the campground. sites.name: Southwest Campground - Winter/Spring
sites.operator: National Park Service · Lassen Volcanic National Park
sites.about: The Southwest Walk-in Campground is located on the east side of the Kohm Yah-mah-nee Visitor Center parking area. sites.name: Elam Creek Picnic Area
sites.restrictions: Include: vehicles in designated parking areas only, no overnight stays permitted, no fireworks, all animals must be on a six (6) foot leash.

sites.name: Elam Creek Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $14 per night
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from a hand pump
sites.about: Elam is a developed campground along upper Deer Creek with 12 designated sites; most can accommodate a small to medium size RV. Fire rings and tables provided. sites.reservations: This campground is non-reservable. All campsites are available on a first come first served basis. Saving campsites is prohibited.

sites.name: Domingo Springs Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $14 per night
sites.about: Domingo Springs is a developed campground with 18 designated sites. Campfire rings and tables are provided. The local Maidu Indians referred to this spot as the "center of the universe". This campground is less than one-half mile from the Pacific Crest Trail. Water from nearby Domingo Spring is…
sites.directions: Chester, CA. From Chester, turn from Highway 36 onto the Warner Valley/Old Bluff Road and travel 8 miles northwest.

sites.name: Alder Creek Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $10 per night
sites.about: Nestled adjacent to the beautiful Deer Creek on CA HWY 32, Alder Creek is a semi-developed campground with 6 designated sites. Please be aware of special fishing regulations when on Deer Creek. See the California Department Fish and Wildlife website for the most up to date guidelines.
sites.directions: From Chico, travel east for 46 miles on Highway 32.
